Swing
GUI
1 Main Window
1.1 JFrame f = new JFrame("Title")
ប្រើដើម្បី បង្កើតផ្ទាំង Window មេ (Main Window) សម្រាប់កម្មវិធី Java Swing និងកំណត់ចំណងជើងនៅពេលបង្កើត។
Syntax JFrame f = new JFrame("Title");
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Title"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.2 f.setTitle("Title")
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ ឬផ្លាស់ប្តូរចំណងជើង (Title) របស់ JFrame បន្ទាប់ពីបង្កើត Window រួច។
Syntax f.setTitle("Title");
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame(); f.setTitle("My Java Window"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.3 f.setSize(w, h)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ទទឹង (Width) និងកម្ពស់ (Height) របស់ JFrame ជាភីកសែល (Pixels)។
Syntax f.setSize(width, height);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setSize()"); f.setSize(500, 350); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.4 f.setLocation(x, y)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ទីតាំងរបស់ JFrame នៅលើអេក្រង់ ដោយប្រើកូអរដោនេ x និង y គិតជាភីកសែល។
Syntax f.setLocation(x, y);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setLocation()"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setLocation(100, 100); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.5 f.setBounds(x, y, w, h)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ទីតាំង និងទំហំរបស់ JFrame ក្នុងពេលតែមួយ ដោយកំណត់ x, y, width និង height។
Syntax f.setBounds(x, y, width, height);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setBounds()"); f.setBounds(100, 100, 400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.6 f.setLocationRelativeTo(null)
ប្រើដើម្បី ដាក់ JFrame នៅចំកណ្តាលអេក្រង់។ គួរហៅបន្ទាប់ពីកំណត់ទំហំ និងមុន setVisible(true)។
Syntax f.setLocationRelativeTo(null);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Centered Window"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.7 f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់សកម្មភាពពេលចុចប៊ូតុងបិទ Window។ EXIT_ON_CLOSE បិទកម្មវិធី, DISPOSE_ON_CLOSE បិទ Window នេះ, HIDE_ON_CLOSE លាក់ Window និង DO_NOTHING_ON_CLOSE មិនធ្វើអ្វីទេ។
Syntax f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Close Operation"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.8 f.setVisible(true)
ប្រើដើម្បី បង្ហាញ JFrame នៅលើអេក្រង់។ ប្រើ false ដើម្បីលាក់ Window។
Syntax f.setVisible(true);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Visible Window"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.9 f.setResizable(false)
ប្រើដើម្បី មិនអនុញ្ញាតឱ្យអ្នកប្រើប្តូរទំហំ JFrame ដោយអូសគែម Window។
Syntax f.setResizable(false);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Fixed Size Window"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setResizable(false); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.10 f.setExtendedState(JFrame.MAXIMIZED_BOTH)
ប្រើដើម្បី ពង្រីក JFrame ឱ្យពេញអេក្រង់ទាំងទទឹង និងកម្ពស់។
Syntax f.setExtendedState(JFrame.MAXIMIZED_BOTH);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Maximized Window"); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setExtendedState(JFrame.MAXIMIZED_BOTH); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.11 f.setUndecorated(true)
ប្រើដើម្បី លុប Title Bar និងស៊ុម Window។ ត្រូវហៅមុន Window ត្រូវបានបង្ហាញ។
Syntax f.setUndecorated(true);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Undecorated Window"); f.setUndecorated(true); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.12 f.setAlwaysOnTop(true)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ឱ្យ JFrame ស្ថិតនៅខាងមុខ Window ផ្សេងៗជានិច្ច នៅពេលប្រព័ន្ធប្រតិបត្តិការអនុញ្ញាត។
Syntax f.setAlwaysOnTop(true);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Always On Top"); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setAlwaysOnTop(true); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.13 f.setIconImage(image)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់រូបតំណាង (Icon) របស់ JFrame ដោយប្រើរូបភាពដែលបានផ្ទុកពីឯកសារ។
Syntax f.setIconImage(image);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.ImageIcon; import java.awt.Image; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Custom Icon"); Image image = new ImageIcon("icon.png").getImage(); f.setIconImage(image); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.14 f.setJMenuBar(menuBar)
ប្រើដើម្បី ភ្ជាប់ JMenuBar ទៅ JFrame ដើម្បីបង្ហាញម៉ឺនុយ ដូចជា File និង Help។
Syntax f.setJMenuBar(menuBar);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JMenu; import javax.swing.JMenuBar; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Menu Bar"); JMenuBar menuBar = new JMenuBar(); JMenu file = new JMenu("File"); menuBar.add(file); f.setJMenuBar(menuBar); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.15 f.setContentPane(panel)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ JPanel ជាផ្ទៃមាតិកាសំខាន់របស់ JFrame។
Syntax f.setContentPane(panel);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JPanel; import javax.swing.JButton; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Content Pane"); JPanel panel = new JPanel(); panel.add(new JButton("Click Me")); f.setContentPane(panel); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.16 f.getContentPane()
ប្រើដើម្បី ទទួលបាន Container ដែលជាផ្ទៃមាតិកា (Content Pane) របស់ JFrame សម្រាប់បន្ថែម Components។
Syntax Container content = f.getContentPane();
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JButton; import java.awt.Container; import java.awt.FlowLayout; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Content Pane"); Container content = f.getContentPane(); content.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); content.add(new JButton("Click Me")); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.17 f.setLayout(layoutManager)
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ Layout Manager សម្រាប់រៀបចំទីតាំង និងទំហំរបស់ Components ក្នុង Content Pane របស់ JFrame។
Syntax f.setLayout(layoutManager);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JButton; import java.awt.FlowLayout; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("FlowLayout"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JButton("One")); f.add(new JButton("Two")); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.18 f.add(component)
ប្រើដើម្បី បន្ថែម Component ដូចជា JButton ទៅក្នុង Content Pane របស់ JFrame។
Syntax f.add(component);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JButton; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Add Component"); JButton button = new JButton("Click Me"); f.add(button); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.19 f.add(component, BorderLayout.NORTH)
ប្រើដើម្បី បន្ថែម Component នៅទីតាំងជាក់លាក់ក្នុង BorderLayout ដូចជា NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST ឬ CENTER។
Syntax f.add(component, BorderLayout.NORTH);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JButton; import java.awt.BorderLayout; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("BorderLayout"); f.setLayout(new BorderLayout()); f.add(new JButton("North"), BorderLayout.NORTH); f.add(new JButton("Center"), BorderLayout.CENTER); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.20 f.remove(component)
ប្រើដើម្បី ដក Component ចេញពី JFrame។ បន្ទាប់ពីដកចេញ ត្រូវហៅ revalidate() និង repaint() ដើម្បីធ្វើបច្ចុប្បន្នភាពការបង្ហាញ។
Syntax f.remove(component);
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JButton; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Remove Component"); JButton button = new JButton("Remove Me"); f.add(button); button.addActionListener(e -> { f.remove(button); f.revalidate(); f.repaint(); }); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.21 f.pack()
ប្រើដើម្បី កំណត់ទំហំ JFrame ឱ្យសមនឹងទំហំដែល Components និង Layout Manager ត្រូវការ។
Syntax f.pack();
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JButton; import java.awt.FlowLayout; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("pack()"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JButton("Click Me")); f.pack(); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.22 f.dispose()
ប្រើដើម្បី បិទ JFrame និងបញ្ចេញធនធានរបស់ Window នោះ។
Syntax f.dispose();
Example
import javax.swing.JFrame; import javax.swing.JButton; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("dispose()"); JButton button = new JButton("Close Window"); button.addActionListener(e -> f.dispose()); f.add(button); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
1.23 f.getTitle()
ប្រើដើម្បី ទទួលបានចំណងជើងបច្ចុប្បន្នរបស់ JFrame ហើយរក្សាទុកជាអថេរ String។

import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("My Window"); String title = f.getTitle(); System.out.println(title); f.dispose(); } }

My Window

Syntax int width = f.getWidth();

import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Width"); f.setSize(400, 300); System.out.println(f.getWidth()); f.dispose(); } }

Syntax int height = f.getHeight();

import javax.swing.JFrame; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Height"); f.setSize(400, 300); System.out.println(f.getHeight()); f.dispose(); } }

import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setSize()"); JButton c = new JButton("Click"); c.setSize(150, 50); f.setLayout(null); c.setLocation(50, 50); f.add(c); f.setSize(300, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

បង្កើត JPanel ដោយប្រើ BorderLayout ដែលរៀបចំ Component ជា ៥ តំបន់៖ NORTH, SOUTH, EAST, WEST និង CENTER។
Syntax new JPanel(new BorderLayout());
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("BorderLayout"); JPanel p = new JPanel(new BorderLayout()); p.add(new JButton("North"), BorderLayout.NORTH); p.add(new JButton("South"), BorderLayout.SOUTH); p.add(new JButton("West"), BorderLayout.WEST); p.add(new JButton("East"), BorderLayout.EAST); p.add(new JButton("Center"), BorderLayout.CENTER); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
3.3 new JPanel(new GridLayout(rows, cols))
បង្កើត JPanel ដោយប្រើ GridLayout ដែលរៀបចំ Component ជាជួរដេក និងជួរឈរ ដែលមានទំហំស្មើគ្នា។
Syntax new JPanel(new GridLayout(rows, cols));
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("GridLayout"); JPanel p = new JPanel(new GridLayout(2, 2, 5, 5)); p.add(new JButton("1")); p.add(new JButton("2")); p.add(new JButton("3")); p.add(new JButton("4")); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
3.4 new JPanel(new FlowLayout())
បង្កើត JPanel ដោយប្រើ FlowLayout ដែលរៀបចំ Component តាមលំដាប់ពីឆ្វេងទៅស្តាំ ហើយបន្តទៅជួរថ្មីនៅពេលមិនមានកន្លែងគ្រប់គ្រាន់។
Syntax new JPanel(new FlowLayout());
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("FlowLayout"); JPanel p = new JPanel(new FlowLayout()); p.add(new JButton("One")); p.add(new JButton("Two")); p.add(new JButton("Three")); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
3.5 p.add(c)
បន្ថែម Component c ទៅក្នុង JPanel p។
Syntax p.add(c);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("add()"); JPanel p = new JPanel(); JButton c = new JButton("Added Button"); p.add(c); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4 JLabel
4.1 JLabel l = new JLabel("text")
បង្កើត JLabel សម្រាប់បង្ហាញអត្ថបទនៅលើ Window។
Syntax JLabel l = new JLabel("text");
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JLabel"); JLabel l = new JLabel("Hello Java"); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.2 new JLabel("text", SwingConstants.CENTER)
បង្កើត JLabel ដែលដាក់អត្ថបទនៅកណ្ដាលតាមទិសផ្ដេក។
Syntax JLabel l = new JLabel("text", SwingConstants.CENTER);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Centered JLabel"); JLabel l = new JLabel("Welcome", SwingConstants.CENTER); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.3 new JLabel(icon)
បង្កើត JLabel សម្រាប់បង្ហាញរូបភាព Icon។
Syntax JLabel l = new JLabel(icon);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JLabel Icon"); ImageIcon icon = new ImageIcon("abstract.png"); JLabel l = new JLabel(icon); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.4 l.setText("new")
ផ្លាស់ប្ដូរអត្ថបទដែលបង្ហាញនៅក្នុង JLabel។
Syntax l.setText("new");
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setText"); JLabel l = new JLabel("Old Text"); l.setText("New Text"); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.5 l.getText()
ទទួលយកអត្ថបទបច្ចុប្បន្នពី JLabel ហើយបង្ហាញវានៅក្នុង Console។
Syntax String text = l.getText();
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JLabel l = new JLabel("Hello Java"); String text = l.getText(); System.out.println(text); } }
Output
Hello Java
4.6 l.setIcon(icon)
កំណត់ ឬផ្លាស់ប្ដូរ Icon របស់ JLabel។
Syntax l.setIcon(icon);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setIcon"); JLabel l = new JLabel("RUPP"); ImageIcon icon = new ImageIcon("rupp.png"); l.setIcon(icon); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.7 l.setHorizontalAlignment(SwingConstants.CENTER)
កំណត់ទីតាំង JLabel តាមទិសផ្ដេក ដូចជា LEFT, CENTER ឬ RIGHT។
Syntax l.setHorizontalAlignment(SwingConstants.CENTER);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Horizontal Alignment"); JLabel l = new JLabel("Centered", SwingConstants.LEFT); l.setHorizontalAlignment(SwingConstants.CENTER); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.8 l.setVerticalAlignment(SwingConstants.TOP)
កំណត់ទីតាំងមាតិកា JLabel តាមទិសបញ្ឈរ ដូចជា TOP, CENTER ឬ BOTTOM។
Syntax l.setVerticalAlignment(SwingConstants.TOP);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Vertical Alignment"); JLabel l = new JLabel("Top Text"); l.setVerticalAlignment(SwingConstants.TOP); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.9 l.setHorizontalTextPosition(SwingConstants.RIGHT)
កំណត់ទីតាំងអត្ថបទធៀបនឹង Icon របស់ JLabel។ RIGHT ដាក់អត្ថបទនៅខាងស្ដាំ Icon។
Syntax l.setHorizontalTextPosition(SwingConstants.RIGHT);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Text Position"); ImageIcon icon = new ImageIcon("rupp.png"); JLabel l = new JLabel("RUPP", icon, SwingConstants.LEFT); l.setHorizontalTextPosition(SwingConstants.RIGHT); f.add(l); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
4.10 l.setLabelFor(component)
ភ្ជាប់ JLabel ទៅនឹង Component មួយ ដូចជា JTextField ដើម្បីជួយឱ្យអ្នកប្រើដឹងថា Label នោះសម្រាប់ Input ណា។
Syntax l.setLabelFor(component);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setLabelFor"); JPanel p = new JPanel(new FlowLayout()); JLabel l = new JLabel("Name:"); JTextField name = new JTextField(15); l.setLabelFor(name); p.add(l); p.add(name); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

5.5 b.setIcon(icon)
កំណត់ ឬផ្លាស់ប្ដូរ Icon របស់ប៊ូតុង។

Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setIcon"); JButton b = new JButton("RUPP"); ImageIcon icon = new ImageIcon("rupp.png"); b.setIcon(icon); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

5.6 b.setMnemonic(KeyEvent.VK_C)
កំណត់គ្រាប់ចុច Alt+C ដើម្បីជ្រើសរើសប៊ូតុងតាមក្តារចុច។ ត្រូវប្រើ KeyEvent ពី java.awt.event។
Syntax b.setMnemonic(KeyEvent.VK_C);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.event.KeyEvent; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Mnemonic"); JButton b = new JButton("Click"); b.setMnemonic(KeyEvent.VK_C); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
5.7 b.setEnabled(false)
បិទមុខងារប៊ូតុង ដើម្បីមិនឱ្យអ្នកប្រើចុចវាបាន។
Syntax b.setEnabled(false);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Disabled Button"); JButton b = new JButton("Disabled"); b.setEnabled(false); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
5.8 b.setFocusPainted(false)
លុបសញ្ញាបង្ហាញ Focus នៅលើប៊ូតុង នៅពេលវាត្រូវបានជ្រើសរើស។
Syntax b.setFocusPainted(false);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Focus Paint"); JButton b = new JButton("Click"); b.setFocusPainted(false); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
5.9 b.setBorderPainted(false)
លុបការគូសស៊ុមរបស់ប៊ូតុង។

Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Border Paint"); JButton b = new JButton("No Border"); b.setBorderPainted(false); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
5.10 b.setContentAreaFilled(false)
លុបការបំពេញពណ៌ផ្ទៃខាងក្នុងប៊ូតុង ដើម្បីឱ្យផ្ទៃខាងក្រោយអាចមើលឃើញតាមរយៈវា។
Syntax b.setContentAreaFilled(false);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Content Area"); JButton b = new JButton("Transparent"); b.setContentAreaFilled(false); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
5.11 b.doClick()
បញ្ជាឱ្យប៊ូតុងដំណើរការដូចជាត្រូវបានចុចដោយកម្មវិធី ហើយហៅ ActionListener របស់វា។
Syntax b.doClick();
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JButton b = new JButton("Click"); b.addActionListener(e -> System.out.println("Button clicked") ); b.doClick(); } }
Output
Button clicked
5.12 b.addActionListener(e -> { ... })
កំណត់សកម្មភាពដែលត្រូវប្រតិបត្តិនៅពេលអ្នកប្រើចុចប៊ូតុង។
Syntax b.addActionListener(e -> { /* action */ });
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Action Listener"); JButton b = new JButton("Click"); b.addActionListener(e -> JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(f, "Button clicked!") ); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
5.13 f.getRootPane().setDefaultButton(b)
កំណត់ប៊ូតុងលំនាំដើមរបស់ JFrame ដើម្បីឱ្យការចុច Enter អាចដំណើរការប៊ូតុងនោះ។
Syntax f.getRootPane().setDefaultButton(b);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Default Button"); JButton b = new JButton("Submit"); b.addActionListener(e -> JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(f, "Submitted!") ); f.add(b); f.getRootPane().setDefaultButton(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Text Alignment"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); JTextField t = new JTextField("Centered Text", 20); t.setHorizontalAlignment(JTextField.CENTER); f.add(t); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
6.9 t.selectAll()
ជ្រើសរើសអត្ថបទទាំងអស់នៅក្នុងប្រអប់ ដើម្បីងាយស្រួលកែប្រែ ឬចម្លង។
Syntax t.selectAll();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("selectAll"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); JTextField t = new JTextField("Select All Text", 20); f.add(t); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); t.selectAll(); t.requestFocusInWindow(); } }
Output
6.10 t.getSelectedText()
ទទួលយកអត្ថបទដែលបានជ្រើសរើសពីប្រអប់អត្ថបទ។ ប្រសិនបើគ្មានអត្ថបទត្រូវបានជ្រើសរើស វានឹងត្រឡប់ null។
Syntax String selected = t.getSelectedText();
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JTextField t = new JTextField("Hello Java"); t.select(0, 5); System.out.println(t.getSelectedText()); } }
Output
Hello
6.11 t.setCaretPosition(0)
កំណត់ទីតាំង Cursor ទៅដើមអត្ថបទ ដោយប្រើទីតាំង 0។
Syntax t.setCaretPosition(0);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Caret Position"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); JTextField t = new JTextField("Hello Java", 20); f.add(t); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); t.setCaretPosition(0); t.requestFocusInWindow(); } }
Output
6.12 t.copy()
ចម្លងអត្ថបទដែលបានជ្រើសរើសទៅ Clipboard។
Syntax t.copy();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Copy Text"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); JTextField t = new JTextField("Copy this text", 20); JButton b = new JButton("Copy"); b.addActionListener(e -> { t.selectAll(); t.copy(); }); f.add(t); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
6.13 t.cut()
កាត់អត្ថបទដែលបានជ្រើសរើស ដោយចម្លងវាទៅ Clipboard ហើយលុបវាចេញពីប្រអប់អត្ថបទ។
Syntax t.cut();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Cut Text"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); JTextField t = new JTextField("Cut this text", 20); JButton b = new JButton("Cut"); b.addActionListener(e -> { t.selectAll(); t.cut(); }); f.add(t); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
6.14 t.paste()
បិទភ្ជាប់អត្ថបទពី Clipboard ទៅទីតាំង Cursor ក្នុងប្រអប់អត្ថបទ។
Syntax t.paste();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Paste Text"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); JTextField t = new JTextField(20); JButton b = new JButton("Paste"); b.addActionListener(e -> t.paste()); f.add(t); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
6.15 t.addActionListener(e -> { ... })
កំណត់សកម្មភាពដែលត្រូវប្រតិបត្តិនៅពេលអ្នកប្រើចុច Enter នៅក្នុងប្រអប់អត្ថបទ។
Syntax t.addActionListener(e -> { /* action */ });
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Text Action"); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); JTextField t = new JTextField(20); t.addActionListener(e -> JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(f, t.getText()) ); f.add(t); f.setSize(400, 200); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

7 JPasswordField
7.1 JPasswordField pw = new JPasswordField(15)
បង្កើតប្រអប់បញ្ចូលពាក្យសម្ងាត់ដែលមានទទឹង 15 columns ហើយតួអក្សរត្រូវបានលាក់។
Syntax JPasswordField pw = new JPasswordField(15);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JPasswordField"); JPasswordField pw = new JPasswordField(15); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JLabel("Password:")); f.add(pw); f.setSize(400, 150); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
7.2 pw.getPassword()
ទទួលបានពាក្យសម្ងាត់ដែលអ្នកប្រើបានបញ្ចូល ជាទម្រង់ array នៃ char (char[])។ វាល្អជាង getText() សម្រាប់ការទទួលយកពាក្យសម្ងាត់។
Syntax char[] password = pw.getPassword();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("getPassword()"); JPasswordField pw = new JPasswordField(15); JButton b = new JButton("Check"); b.addActionListener(e -> { char[] password = pw.getPassword(); JOptionPane.showMessageDialog( f, "Password length: " + password.length ); java.util.Arrays.fill(password, ' '); }); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JLabel("Password:")); f.add(pw); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 180); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
7.3 pw.setEchoChar('*')
កំណត់តួអក្សរដែលបង្ហាញជំនួសពាក្យសម្ងាត់។ ឧទាហរណ៍ ប្រើសញ្ញា * ដើម្បីលាក់តួអក្សរដែលបានបញ្ចូល។
Syntax pw.setEchoChar('*');
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setEchoChar()"); JPasswordField pw = new JPasswordField(15); pw.setEchoChar('*'); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JLabel("Password:")); f.add(pw); f.setSize(400, 150); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
7.4 new String(pw.getPassword())
បម្លែង char[] ដែលបានពី getPassword() ទៅជា String ដើម្បីងាយស្រួលប្រើ។ សូមប្រើដោយប្រុងប្រយ័ត្ន ព្រោះ String មិនអាចលុបមាតិកាដោយផ្ទាល់បានទេ។
Syntax String password = new String(pw.getPassword());
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; import java.util.Arrays; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Convert Password"); JPasswordField pw = new JPasswordField(15); JButton b = new JButton("Submit"); b.addActionListener(e -> { char[] chars = pw.getPassword(); String password = new String(chars); JOptionPane.showMessageDialog( f, "Password entered: " + password ); Arrays.fill(chars, ' '); }); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JLabel("Password:")); f.add(pw); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 180); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
8 JTextArea
8.1 JTextArea ta = new JTextArea(rows, cols)
បង្កើតប្រអប់សម្រាប់បញ្ចូល ឬបង្ហាញអត្ថបទច្រើនបន្ទាត់ ដោយកំណត់ចំនួនជួរដេក (rows) និងជួរឈរ (cols)។

import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JTextArea"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea(5, 20); JScrollPane sp = new JScrollPane(ta); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(sp); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

ទទួលបានអត្ថបទទាំងអស់ដែលមាននៅក្នុង JTextArea ជា String។
Syntax String text = ta.getText();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("getText()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Hello Java", 5, 20); JButton b = new JButton("Get Text"); b.addActionListener(e -> JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(f, ta.getText()) ); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

8.3 ta.setText("text")

Syntax ta.setText("text");
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setText()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Old text", 5, 20); JButton b = new JButton("Set Text"); b.addActionListener(e -> ta.setText("New text")); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
8.4 ta.append("more")
បន្ថែមអត្ថបទថ្មីនៅចុងបញ្ចប់នៃអត្ថបទដែលមានស្រាប់ ដោយមិនលុបអត្ថបទចាស់។
Syntax ta.append("more");
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("append()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Hello", 5, 20); JButton b = new JButton("Append"); b.addActionListener(e -> ta.append(" Java")); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
8.5 ta.insert("text", position)
បញ្ចូលអត្ថបទនៅទីតាំងដែលបានកំណត់ (position) ក្នុងអត្ថបទដែលមានស្រាប់។ ទីតាំងចាប់ផ្ដើមពី 0។
Syntax ta.insert("text", position);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("insert()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Hello World", 5, 20); JButton b = new JButton("Insert"); b.addActionListener(e -> ta.insert("Java ", 6)); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
8.6 ta.replaceRange("text", start, end)
ជំនួសអត្ថបទចាប់ពីទីតាំង start រហូតដល់ទីតាំង end ដោយអត្ថបទថ្មី។ ទីតាំង end មិនត្រូវបានរាប់បញ្ចូលទេ។
Syntax ta.replaceRange("text", start, end);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("replaceRange()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Hello World", 5, 20); JButton b = new JButton("Replace"); b.addActionListener(e -> ta.replaceRange("Java", 6, 11) ); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
8.7 ta.setEditable(false)
កំណត់ឱ្យ JTextArea មិនអាចកែប្រែអត្ថបទបាន។ អត្ថបទនៅតែអាចអាន និងជ្រើសរើសបាន។
Syntax ta.setEditable(false);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setEditable()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Read only text", 5, 20); ta.setEditable(false); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.setSize(400, 220); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
8.8 ta.setLineWrap(true)
កំណត់ឱ្យអត្ថបទវែងបន្តទៅបន្ទាត់ថ្មីដោយស្វ័យប្រវត្តិ នៅពេលវាដល់គែមប្រអប់។

import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setLineWrap()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea( "This is a long sentence that wraps to the next line.", 5, 15 ); ta.setLineWrap(true); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.setSize(350, 230); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

8.11 ta.getLineCount()

import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("getLineCount()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Line 1\nLine 2\nLine 3", 5, 20); JButton b = new JButton("Count Lines"); b.addActionListener(e -> JOptionPane.showMessageDialog( f, "Lines: " + ta.getLineCount() ) ); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

8.12 ta.getSelectedText()

Syntax String selected = ta.getSelectedText();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("getSelectedText()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea("Select some text", 5, 20); JButton b = new JButton("Get Selected"); b.addActionListener(e -> { String selected = ta.getSelectedText(); JOptionPane.showMessageDialog( f, selected == null ? "No text selected" : selected ); }); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

8.15 ta.setCaretPosition(ta.getDocument().getLength())
ផ្លាស់ទី cursor ទៅចុងបញ្ចប់នៃអត្ថបទ។ ប្រើជាមួយ JScrollPane ដើម្បីអាចបង្ហាញបន្ទាត់ចុងក្រោយនៅពេលបន្ថែមអត្ថបទថ្មី។
Syntax ta.setCaretPosition(ta.getDocument().getLength());
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Scroll to Bottom"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea(5, 20); JScrollPane sp = new JScrollPane(ta); JButton b = new JButton("Add Line"); b.addActionListener(e -> { ta.append("New line\n"); ta.setCaretPosition( ta.getDocument().getLength() ); }); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(sp); f.add(b); f.setSize(400, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
8.16 ta.setFont(new Font("Monospaced", Font.PLAIN, 14))
កំណត់ពុម្ពអក្សររបស់ JTextArea ឱ្យជា Monospaced ទំហំ 14 និងរចនាប័ទ្មធម្មតា។ ពុម្ពអក្សរនេះមានទទឹងតួអក្សរស្មើគ្នា ដែលសមស្របសម្រាប់បង្ហាញកូដ។
Syntax ta.setFont(new Font("Monospaced", Font.PLAIN, 14));
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setFont()"); JTextArea ta = new JTextArea( "public class Main {\n public static void main(String[] args) {\n }\n}", 6, 25 ); ta.setFont(new Font("Monospaced", Font.PLAIN, 14)); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ta)); f.setSize(450, 250); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("HTML Bold Text"); JEditorPane ep = new JEditorPane(); ep.setContentType("text/html"); ep.setText("bold"); ep.setEditable(false); f.setLayout(new BorderLayout()); f.add(ep, BorderLayout.CENTER); f.setSize(400, 180); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; import java.net.URL; import java.io.IOException; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setPage()"); JEditorPane ep = new JEditorPane(); ep.setEditable(false); try { URL url = new URL("https://example.com"); ep.setPage(url); } catch (IOException e) { ep.setText("Unable to load the page."); } f.setLayout(new BorderLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(ep), BorderLayout.CENTER); f.setSize(600, 400); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

13.18 list.addListSelectionListener(e -> { ... })
បន្ថែម Listener ដើម្បីឆ្លើយតបនៅពេលការជ្រើសរើសក្នុង JList ផ្លាស់ប្តូរ។ ប្រើ e.getValueIsAdjusting() ដើម្បីពិនិត្យថាការជ្រើសរើសកំពុងផ្លាស់ប្តូរឬអត់។
Syntax list.addListSelectionListener(e -> { ... });
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("ListSelectionListener"); DefaultListModel<String> model = new DefaultListModel<>(); model.addElement("Apple"); model.addElement("Banana"); model.addElement("Orange"); JList<String> list = new JList<>(model); JLabel label = new JLabel("Select an item"); list.addListSelectionListener(e -> { if (!e.getValueIsAdjusting()) { label.setText("Selected: " + list.getSelectedValue()); } }); f.setLayout(new FlowLayout()); f.add(new JScrollPane(list)); f.add(label); f.setSize(350, 220); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("DefaultTableModel"); String[] cols = {"Name", "Age"}; DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(cols, 0); JTable table = new JTable(tm); f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JTable"); String[] cols = {"Name", "Age"}; DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(cols, 0); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Bob", 22}); JTable table = new JTable(tm); f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
14.3 tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20})

Syntax tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20});
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("addRow()"); DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(new String[]{"Name", "Age"}, 0); JTable table = new JTable(tm); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20}); f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

Syntax tm.removeRow(i);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("removeRow()"); DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(new String[]{"Name", "Age"}, 0); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Bob", 22}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Cat", 19}); tm.removeRow(1); // removes Bob JTable table = new JTable(tm); f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setValueAt()"); DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(new String[]{"Name", "Age"}, 0); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20}); tm.setValueAt(25, 0, 1); // Age of row 0 becomes 25 JTable table = new JTable(tm); f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("getSelectedRow()"); DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(new String[]{"Name", "Age"}, 0); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Bob", 22}); JTable table = new JTable(tm); table.setRowSelectionInterval(1, 1); // select row 1 JLabel label = new JLabel("Selected row: " + table.getSelectedRow()); f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.add(label, BorderLayout.SOUTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

Syntax int[] rows = table.getSelectedRows();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("getSelectedRows()"); DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(new String[]{"Name", "Age"}, 0); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Bob", 22}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Cat", 19}); JTable table = new JTable(tm); table.setRowSelectionInterval(0, 1); // select rows 0 and 1 JLabel label = new JLabel("Selected count: " + table.getSelectedRows().length); f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.add(label, BorderLayout.SOUTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.table.DefaultTableModel; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("RowSorter"); DefaultTableModel tm = new DefaultTableModel(new String[]{"Name", "Age"}, 0); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Cat", 19}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Ann", 20}); tm.addRow(new Object[]{"Bob", 22}); JTable table = new JTable(tm); table.setAutoCreateRowSorter(true); // click a header to sort f.add(new JScrollPane(table)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

15 JScrollPane
15.1 new JScrollPane(component)
បង្កើត JScrollPane ដែលរុំ Component ដើម្បីឲ្យអាចរមូរ (scroll) មើលបាន នៅពេលមាតិកាធំជាងទំហំបង្ហាញ។
Syntax JScrollPane sp = new JScrollPane(component);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JScrollPane"); JTextArea component = new JTextArea(); for (int i = 1; i <= 30; i++) { component.append("Line " + i + "\n"); } JScrollPane sp = new JScrollPane(component); f.add(sp); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
15.2 new JScrollPane()
បង្កើត JScrollPane ដោយកំណត់គោលនយោបាយ Scrollbar។ VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS បង្ហាញ Scrollbar បញ្ឈរជានិច្ច ហើយ HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER មិនបង្ហាញ Scrollbar ផ្ដេកទាល់តែសោះ។
Syntax new JScrollPane(component, JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS, JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("Scrollbar Policy"); JTextArea component = new JTextArea("Short text"); JScrollPane sp = new JScrollPane(component, JScrollPane.VERTICAL_SCROLLBAR_ALWAYS, JScrollPane.HORIZONTAL_SCROLLBAR_NEVER); f.add(sp); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
15.3 sp.setViewportView(component)
កំណត់ ឬប្តូរ Component ដែលត្រូវបង្ហាញនៅក្នុង Viewport របស់ JScrollPane។
Syntax sp.setViewportView(component);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setViewportView()"); JScrollPane sp = new JScrollPane(); JTextArea component = new JTextArea(); for (int i = 1; i <= 30; i++) { component.append("Line " + i + "\n"); } sp.setViewportView(component); f.add(sp); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
15.4 sp.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(max)
រមូរ Scrollbar បញ្ឈរទៅទីតាំងដែលកំណត់។ ប្រើ getMaximum() ដើម្បីរមូរទៅបាតបំផុត។
Syntax sp.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(max);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setValue()"); JTextArea component = new JTextArea(); for (int i = 1; i <= 50; i++) { component.append("Line " + i + "\n"); } JScrollPane sp = new JScrollPane(component); f.add(sp); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); SwingUtilities.invokeLater(() -> { int max = sp.getVerticalScrollBar().getMaximum(); sp.getVerticalScrollBar().setValue(max); // scroll to bottom }); } }
Output

import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { String s = JOptionPane.showInputDialog("Enter name:"); if (s != null) { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "Hello, " + s); } } }

Syntax String s = JOptionPane.showInputDialog(null, "msg", "Title", JOptionPane.QUESTION_MESSAGE);

import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { String s = JOptionPane.showInputDialog(null, "What is your age?", "Age", JOptionPane.QUESTION_MESSAGE); if (s != null) { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "You entered: " + s); } } }
Output
16.5 JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog() // YES_OPTION, NO_OPTION, CANCEL_OPTION
បង្ហាញប្រអប់បញ្ជាក់ដែលមានប៊ូតុង Yes, No និង Cancel។ លទ្ធផលជា int ដែលអាចប្រៀបធៀបជាមួយ YES_OPTION, NO_OPTION ឬ CANCEL_OPTION។
Syntax int r = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(null, "Sure?"); // YES_OPTION, NO_OPTION, CANCEL_OPTION
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { int r = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(null, "Sure?"); if (r == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "You chose Yes"); } else if (r == JOptionPane.NO_OPTION) { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "You chose No"); } else { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "You chose Cancel"); } } }
Output
16.6 JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog()
បង្ហាញប្រអប់បញ្ជាក់ដែលមានចំណងជើង និងមានតែប៊ូតុង Yes និង No ប៉ុណ្ណោះ។
Syntax int r = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(null, "Sure?", "Title", JOptionPane.YES_NO_OPTION);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { int r = JOptionPane.showConfirmDialog(null, "Delete this file?", "Confirm", JOptionPane.YES_NO_OPTION); if (r == JOptionPane.YES_OPTION) { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "Deleted"); } } }

import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { String[] options = {"A", "B"}; int r = JOptionPane.showOptionDialog(null, "Choose an option", "Options", JOptionPane.DEFAULT_OPTION, JOptionPane.INFORMATION_MESSAGE, null, options, "A"); if (r != -1) { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(null, "You clicked: " + options[r]); } } }

Syntax mi.setAccelerator(KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(KeyEvent.VK_O, InputEvent.CTRL_DOWN_MASK));
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.event.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setAccelerator()"); JMenuBar mb = new JMenuBar(); JMenu menu = new JMenu("File"); JMenuItem mi = new JMenuItem("Open"); mi.setAccelerator(KeyStroke.getKeyStroke(KeyEvent.VK_O, InputEvent.CTRL_DOWN_MASK)); menu.add(mi); mb.add(menu); f.setJMenuBar(mb); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
17.10 mi.setMnemonic()
កំណត់អក្សរ Mnemonic ឲ្យ JMenuItem។ នៅពេលបើកម៉ឺនុយ អ្នកអាចចុចអក្សរនោះដើម្បីជ្រើសធាតុ ហើយអក្សរនោះនឹងមានបន្ទាត់គូសពីក្រោម។ ត្រូវ import java.awt.event.*។
Syntax mi.setMnemonic(KeyEvent.VK_O);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.event.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setMnemonic()"); JMenuBar mb = new JMenuBar(); JMenu menu = new JMenu("File"); menu.setMnemonic(KeyEvent.VK_F); // Alt+F opens the menu JMenuItem mi = new JMenuItem("Open"); mi.setMnemonic(KeyEvent.VK_O); // press O while the menu is open menu.add(mi); mb.add(menu); f.setJMenuBar(mb); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

Syntax mi.addActionListener(e -> { ... });
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("addActionListener()"); JMenuBar mb = new JMenuBar(); JMenu menu = new JMenu("File"); JMenuItem mi = new JMenuItem("Open"); mi.addActionListener(e -> { JOptionPane.showMessageDialog(f, "Open clicked"); }); menu.add(mi); mb.add(menu); f.setJMenuBar(mb); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

Syntax JPopupMenu pm = new JPopupMenu(); // right-click menu
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JPopupMenu"); JPanel p = new JPanel(); JPopupMenu pm = new JPopupMenu(); // right-click menu pm.add(new JMenuItem("Copy")); pm.add(new JMenuItem("Paste")); p.setComponentPopupMenu(pm); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
17.13 pm.show()
បង្ហាញ JPopupMenu នៅទីតាំង (x, y) ដែលទាក់ទងនឹង Component ដែលបានកំណត់។ ជាទូទៅប្រើជាមួយ MouseListener។
Syntax pm.show(component, x, y);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.event.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("pm.show()"); JPanel p = new JPanel(); JPopupMenu pm = new JPopupMenu(); pm.add(new JMenuItem("Copy")); pm.add(new JMenuItem("Paste")); p.addMouseListener(new MouseAdapter() { public void mousePressed(MouseEvent e) { if (SwingUtilities.isRightMouseButton(e)) { pm.show(e.getComponent(), e.getX(), e.getY()); } } }); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("addChangeListener()"); JSpinner sp = new JSpinner(new SpinnerNumberModel(5, 0, 10, 1)); JLabel label = new JLabel("Value: 5"); sp.addChangeListener(e -> { label.setText("Value: " + sp.getValue()); }); JPanel p = new JPanel(new FlowLayout()); p.add(sp); p.add(label); f.add(p); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
22 JSplitPane
22.1 new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, left, right)
បង្កើត JSplitPane ដែលចែកផ្ទៃជាពីរផ្នែក។ HORIZONTAL_SPLIT ដាក់ Component ទាំងពីរឆ្វេង និងស្តាំ ហើយ VERTICAL_SPLIT ដាក់វាលើ និងក្រោម។ អ្នកប្រើអាចអូសបន្ទាត់ខណ្ឌ (Divider) ដើម្បីប្តូរទំហំ។
Syntax JSplitPane split = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, left, right); // or VERTICAL_SPLIT
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JSplitPane"); JLabel left = new JLabel("Left", SwingConstants.CENTER); JLabel right = new JLabel("Right", SwingConstants.CENTER); JSplitPane split = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, left, right); f.add(split); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
22.2 split.setDividerLocation()
កំណត់ទីតាំងនៃបន្ទាត់ខណ្ឌ (Divider) គិតជា pixel ពីគែមខាងឆ្វេង (ឬខាងលើ បើជា VERTICAL_SPLIT)។
Syntax split.setDividerLocation(200);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setDividerLocation()"); JLabel left = new JLabel("Left", SwingConstants.CENTER); JLabel right = new JLabel("Right", SwingConstants.CENTER); JSplitPane split = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, left, right); split.setDividerLocation(200); // divider 200 px from the left f.add(split); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
22.3 split.setResizeWeight()
កំណត់ថាតើទំហំបន្ថែមត្រូវចែកឲ្យផ្នែកណា នៅពេលប្តូរទំហំបង្អួច។ 0 គឺផ្នែកខាងស្តាំ (ឬក្រោម) ទទួលទាំងអស់ 1 គឺផ្នែកខាងឆ្វេង (ឬលើ) ទទួលទាំងអស់ ហើយ 0.5 គឺចែកស្មើគ្នា។
Syntax split.setResizeWeight(0.5);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setResizeWeight()"); JLabel left = new JLabel("Left", SwingConstants.CENTER); JLabel right = new JLabel("Right", SwingConstants.CENTER); JSplitPane split = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, left, right); split.setResizeWeight(0.5); // extra space is shared equally split.setDividerLocation(200); f.add(split); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
22.4 split.setOneTouchExpandable()
បង្ហាញព្រួញតូចៗនៅលើ Divider ដើម្បីឲ្យអ្នកប្រើចុចមួយដងទុកផ្នែកណាមួយឲ្យបត់ ឬពង្រីកពេញ។
Syntax split.setOneTouchExpandable(true);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setOneTouchExpandable()"); JLabel left = new JLabel("Left", SwingConstants.CENTER); JLabel right = new JLabel("Right", SwingConstants.CENTER); JSplitPane split = new JSplitPane(JSplitPane.HORIZONTAL_SPLIT, left, right); split.setOneTouchExpandable(true); // small arrows appear on the divider split.setDividerLocation(200); f.add(split); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
23 JToolBar
23.1 new JToolBar()
បង្កើត JToolBar ជារបារឧបករណ៍ សម្រាប់ដាក់ប៊ូតុង ឬ Component ផ្សេងៗដែលប្រើញឹកញាប់។ ជាទូទៅដាក់នៅផ្នែកខាងលើនៃ JFrame ដោយប្រើ BorderLayout.NORTH។
Syntax JToolBar tool = new JToolBar();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JToolBar"); JToolBar tool = new JToolBar(); tool.add(new JButton("New")); f.add(tool, BorderLayout.NORTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
23.2 tool.add(button)
បន្ថែមប៊ូតុង ឬ Component ទៅក្នុង JToolBar។ Component ត្រូវបានរៀបតាមលំដាប់ពីឆ្វេងទៅស្តាំ។
Syntax tool.add(button);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("tool.add()"); JToolBar tool = new JToolBar(); JButton button = new JButton("New"); tool.add(button); tool.add(new JButton("Open")); tool.add(new JButton("Save")); f.add(tool, BorderLayout.NORTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
23.3 tool.addSeparator()

Syntax tool.addSeparator();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("addSeparator()"); JToolBar tool = new JToolBar(); tool.add(new JButton("New")); tool.add(new JButton("Open")); tool.addSeparator(); tool.add(new JButton("Exit")); f.add(tool, BorderLayout.NORTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
23.4 tool.setFloatable(false)
កំណត់ថាតើអ្នកប្រើអាចអូស JToolBar ចេញពីទីតាំងដើមឲ្យអណ្តែតបានឬទេ។ បើ false របារឧបករណ៍នឹងជាប់នឹងកន្លែង ហើយមិនមានចំណុចសម្រាប់អូស (grip) ទៀតទេ។
Syntax tool.setFloatable(false);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("setFloatable()"); JToolBar tool = new JToolBar(); tool.setFloatable(false); // cannot be dragged out tool.add(new JButton("New")); tool.add(new JButton("Open")); f.add(tool, BorderLayout.NORTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
24 JSeparator
24.1 new JSeparator(SwingConstants.HORIZONTAL)
បង្កើត JSeparator ជាបន្ទាត់បំបែកសម្រាប់ញែក Component ជាក្រុមៗ។ SwingConstants.HORIZONTAL ធ្វើឲ្យបន្ទាត់ដេក ហើយ SwingConstants.VERTICAL ធ្វើឲ្យបន្ទាត់ឈរ។
Syntax new JSeparator(SwingConstants.HORIZONTAL);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JSeparator"); JPanel p = new JPanel(new BorderLayout(0, 10)); p.add(new JLabel("Above the line", SwingConstants.CENTER), BorderLayout.NORTH); p.add(new JSeparator(SwingConstants.HORIZONTAL), BorderLayout.CENTER); p.add(new JLabel("Below the line", SwingConstants.CENTER), BorderLayout.SOUTH); f.add(p, BorderLayout.NORTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }

25 JTree
25.1 new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root")
បង្កើត DefaultMutableTreeNode ជា Node មួយនៃ JTree។ Node ដំបូងគេគឺជា Root ។ ត្រូវ import javax.swing.tree.*។
Syntax DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); // javax.swing.tree
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.tree.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("DefaultMutableTreeNode"); DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); JTree tree = new JTree(root); f.add(new JScrollPane(tree)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
25.2 root.add()
បន្ថែម Node កូន (Child) ទៅក្នុង Node មេ។ Node កូនអាចមានកូនរបស់វាបន្ត ដើម្បីបង្កើតជារចនាសម្ព័ន្ធដើមឈើ។
Syntax root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child"));
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.tree.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("root.add()"); DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 1")); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 2")); JTree tree = new JTree(root); f.add(new JScrollPane(tree)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
25.3 new JTree(root)
បង្កើត JTree ដោយប្រើ Node root ជាឫសនៃដើមឈើ ដើម្បីបង្ហាញទិន្នន័យជាថ្នាក់ៗ។ ជាទូទៅដាក់ក្នុង JScrollPane។
Syntax JTree tree = new JTree(root);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.tree.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("JTree"); DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); DefaultMutableTreeNode child = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child"); child.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Grandchild")); root.add(child); JTree tree = new JTree(root); f.add(new JScrollPane(tree)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
25.4 tree.getLastSelectedPathComponent()
ត្រឡប់ Node ដែលអ្នកប្រើបានជ្រើសរើសចុងក្រោយ ជា Object។ បើមិនមានអ្វីត្រូវបានជ្រើសរើសទេ នឹងត្រឡប់ null។ ត្រូវ cast ទៅ DefaultMutableTreeNode មុនប្រើ។
Syntax Object node = tree.getLastSelectedPathComponent();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.tree.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("getLastSelectedPathComponent()"); DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 1")); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 2")); JTree tree = new JTree(root); tree.expandRow(0); tree.setSelectionRow(1); // select Child 1 DefaultMutableTreeNode node = (DefaultMutableTreeNode) tree.getLastSelectedPathComponent(); JLabel label = new JLabel("Selected: " + node); f.add(new JScrollPane(tree)); f.add(label, BorderLayout.SOUTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
25.5 tree.expandRow(0)
បើក (expand) ជួរដេកនៅ index ដែលបានកំណត់ ដើម្បីបង្ហាញ Node កូនរបស់វា។ ជួរដេក 0 គឺជា Root ។
Syntax tree.expandRow(0);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.tree.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("expandRow()"); DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 1")); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 2")); JTree tree = new JTree(root); tree.expandRow(0); // expand Root f.add(new JScrollPane(tree)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
25.6 tree.collapseRow(0)
បិទ (collapse) ជួរដេកនៅ index ដែលបានកំណត់ ដើម្បីលាក់ Node កូនរបស់វា។
Syntax tree.collapseRow(0);
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.tree.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("collapseRow()"); DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 1")); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 2")); JTree tree = new JTree(root); tree.expandRow(0); tree.collapseRow(0); // collapse Root again f.add(new JScrollPane(tree)); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output
25.7 tree.addTreeSelectionListener()
បន្ថែម TreeSelectionListener ទៅ JTree ដើម្បីដំណើរការកូដរាល់ពេលអ្នកប្រើជ្រើសរើស Node ផ្សេង។ ត្រូវ import javax.swing.event.*។
Syntax tree.addTreeSelectionListener(e -> { ... });
Example
import javax.swing.*; import javax.swing.tree.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame f = new JFrame("addTreeSelectionListener()"); DefaultMutableTreeNode root = new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Root"); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 1")); root.add(new DefaultMutableTreeNode("Child 2")); JTree tree = new JTree(root); tree.expandRow(0); JLabel label = new JLabel("Selected: none"); tree.addTreeSelectionListener(e -> { Object node = tree.getLastSelectedPathComponent(); if (node != null) { label.setText("Selected: " + node); } }); f.add(new JScrollPane(tree)); f.add(label, BorderLayout.SOUTH); f.setSize(400, 300); f.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); f.setLocationRelativeTo(null); f.setVisible(true); } }
Output

import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame frame = new JFrame("Main Window"); frame.setSize(400, 300); frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null); frame.setVisible(true); JDialog d = new JDialog(frame, "Title", true); // true = modal d.setSize(250, 150); d.setVisible(true); } }

Syntax d.setSize(w, h);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame frame = new JFrame("Main Window"); frame.setSize(400, 300); frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null); frame.setVisible(true); JDialog d = new JDialog(frame, "setSize()", true); d.setSize(300, 200); // width 300, height 200 d.setVisible(true); } }
Output

Syntax d.setLocationRelativeTo(frame);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame frame = new JFrame("Main Window"); frame.setSize(400, 300); frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null); frame.setVisible(true); JDialog d = new JDialog(frame, "Centered", true); d.setSize(250, 150); d.setLocationRelativeTo(frame); // center over the frame d.setVisible(true); } }
Output
26.4 d.add(component)
បន្ថែម Component (ឧ. JLabel, JButton, JPanel) ទៅក្នុង JDialog។
Syntax d.add(component);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame frame = new JFrame("Main Window"); frame.setSize(400, 300); frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null); frame.setVisible(true); JDialog d = new JDialog(frame, "d.add()", true); d.add(new JLabel("Hello from the dialog", SwingConstants.CENTER)); d.setSize(250, 150); d.setLocationRelativeTo(frame); d.setVisible(true); } }
Output
26.5 d.setVisible(true)
បង្ហាញ JDialog លើអេក្រង់។ បើ Dialog ជា Modal កូដបន្ទាប់ពីបន្ទាត់នេះនឹងមិនដំណើរការទេ រហូតដល់ Dialog ត្រូវបានបិទ។
Syntax d.setVisible(true);
Example
import javax.swing.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame frame = new JFrame("Main Window"); frame.setSize(400, 300); frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null); frame.setVisible(true); JDialog d = new JDialog(frame, "setVisible()", true); d.add(new JLabel("I am visible", SwingConstants.CENTER)); d.setSize(250, 150); d.setLocationRelativeTo(frame); d.setVisible(true); // modal: code below waits until the dialog closes System.out.println("Dialog closed"); } }
Output
26.6 d.dispose()
បិទ JDialog ហើយបញ្ចេញ Resource ដែលវាប្រើ។ ខុសពី System.exit() ត្រង់ថា វាបិទតែ Dialog ប៉ុណ្ណោះ មិនបិទកម្មវិធីទាំងមូលទេ។
Syntax d.dispose();
Example
import javax.swing.*; import java.awt.*; public class Main { public static void main(String[] args) { JFrame frame = new JFrame("Main Window"); frame.setSize(400, 300); frame.setDefaultCloseOperation(JFrame.EXIT_ON_CLOSE); frame.setLocationRelativeTo(null); frame.setVisible(true); JDialog d = new JDialog(frame, "dispose()", true); JButton close = new JButton("Close"); close.addActionListener(e -> d.dispose()); // closes only the dialog d.add(close, BorderLayout.SOUTH); d.add(new JLabel("Click Close", SwingConstants.CENTER)); d.setSize(250, 150); d.setLocationRelativeTo(frame); d.setVisible(true); } }
Output
